name: Folding platform truck 720 x 470 mm
description:
A folding platform truck (flatbed trolley) of the common 150 kg class: a 720 x 470 mm steel deck with a rubber mat, four 100 mm casters, and a tubular U handle that folds flat over the deck for storage. Overall 730 x 470 x 820 mm with the handle up. One 600 x 400 euro container fits on the deck with room to spare.

External dimensions: length 730 mm, width 470 mm, height 820 mm.

Generic folding platform truck (flatbed trolley) of the common 150 kg class: 720 x 470 mm deck, 100 mm casters, handle folds flat over the deck. Takes one 600 x 400 euro container with room to spare.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 1,692 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
